description: This is a PHP source file defining the SubTotal controller class within the OpenCart admin extension for the total/sub_total functionality. It manages displaying and saving settings related to the subtotal total extension in the admin interface.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: Controller class for the Sub Total extension in the admin area of OpenCart, extending the core Controller class, responsible for rendering the configuration page and saving settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the settings page for the Sub Total extension, loading language strings, setting breadcrumbs, and passing data to the view template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the Sub Total extension via POST request, with permission checks and JSON response.
